name: Worldforged Precious Ring has no duplicate standing in the Valley of Trials
contract: Issue #8583: a player found the Worldforged Precious Ring (item 515383, object 95934) repeated nearby in the Valley of Trials (Durotar), near (-420.158, -4307.51, 43.9616) map 1. The restoration once placed two live copies of this object a few yards apart there: guid 6930084 at (-423, -4303.17) and guid 6942006 at (-424.5, -4299.4). Rev_20261024_90 (fix for #8904) already removed the 6942006 copy as a misplaced spawn, since the item's only recorded spot is Un'Goro Crater. This case checks the other historical duplicate spot (6930084) independently: no live copy of object 95934 stands at either position today.

steps.label: no Precious Ring copy at the 6930084 spot
no Precious Ring copy at the 6942006 spot
